title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for type 2 diabetes.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of type 2 diabetes. He reports feeling well and states that his blood glucose levels have been stable since the last visit. He has been on long-term insulin therapy and reports consistent adherence to his prescribed regimen. He denies any recent acute illnesses or significant changes in his health status. He notes that he is currently without complications related to his condition.

Medication List
- Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. He appears in no acute distress. Physical examination is unremarkable. Skin is intact without lesions. Vital signs are within normal limits.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications.

Plan
1. Continue current insulin regimen as prescribed.
2. Monitor blood glucose levels daily.
3. Follow up in three months for a laboratory review and continued management of type 2 diabetes.
explanations: No complication is documented: type 2 diabetes without complications.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: Nothing in the note documents hyperglycemia or poor control.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
